title: Theo and the Deadline
premise: Elodie Crane, a private security contractor who guards clients nobody trusts, receives a calendar invitation from her handler Marcus Vane — sent two days after his confirmed death. Following it, she finds herself embedded in a reunion of the network that trained her: a black-ops program called Lantern that manufactures loyal operatives by editing their memories. As Elodie investigates Vane's murder, she discovers her own polished past is a fabrication and that the invitation was Vane's posthumous trap to force her to burn Lantern from inside. Betrayed by the one colleague she trusts, she chooses truth over loyalty, exposes Lantern's ledger of stolen lives at a summit of its buyers, and walks away with nothing but her real name — which she finally learns in the last chapter.
about_author: Odile Dravenmoor is the pen name of a former risk analyst who spent a decade writing threat assessments for people who preferred their secrets intact. She writes thrillers about the moment loyalty becomes a liability.

chapters.title: The Packed Bag
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. A routine protection detail in Rotterdam goes sideways when her client lies to her about who else is in the building. We see her competence, her go-bag ritual, and the lie she tells herself: that she's free. Emotional beat: controlled unease — the reader learns Elodie trusts no one, including herself.

chapters.title: Invitation from a Dead Man
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Her phone chimes: a calendar invite from Marcus Vane, her handler, for tomorrow at 9 a.m. — but Vane died three days ago, officially by suicide. She verifies the death twice, then packs the bag anyway. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into compulsion; grief weaponized.

chapters.title: Nine O'Clock
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. The meeting place is a decommissioned customs house where Vane once briefed her. Instead of Vane, she finds four strangers who all received the same invitation — and all trained under the same program. Emotional beat: vertigo; her solitary world suddenly crowded with mirrors.

chapters.title: Lantern
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs begin. The four reveal themselves as Lantern alumni: operatives whose memories were edited to guarantee loyalty. One, Sefu Adeyemi, recognizes Elodie from a mission she has no memory of. Emotional beat: the floor tilts — her identity is now evidence, not fact.

chapters.title: What Vane Left
chapters.summary: Sefu's POV. In a locker keyed to the invitation, they find Vane's dead-man's-switch package: partial files on Lantern's memory protocol and a note — 'One of you is still theirs.' Emotional beat: paranoia blooms; trust becomes a tactical problem.

chapters.title: The Polished Lie
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. She audits her own past like a crime scene: photos that don't quite match weather records, a mother who answers questions too smoothly. First confirmation that her childhood was installed. Emotional beat: quiet horror — mourning a life that never happened.

chapters.title: Buyers and Sellers
chapters.summary: New POV: Ilsa Rehn, a Lantern administrator, learns the alumni have met and activates containment protocols. We see the network's cold economics — loyalty as a product line. Emotional beat: institutional menace; the antagonist's calm is scarier than violence.

chapters.title: Safehouse Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. The group holes up in Sefu's safehouse and counts what they know against what could be planted. Elodie argues for burning the network; another alumnus, Petra Lindqvist, argues some edits were mercy. Emotional beat: the theme crystallizes — loyalty vs. truth as a live argument, not a slogan.

chapters.title: Ghost Protocol
chapters.summary: Sefu's POV. They trace Vane's last movements to a clinic in Lyon where the memory work happens. Surveillance footage shows Vane alive after his 'suicide' — and shows Elodie's face on the visitor log, a visit she cannot remember. Emotional beat: betrayal without a traitor yet named.

chapters.title: The Session
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Under Sefu's supervision, she attempts a guided recovery of the Lyon memory and surfaces fragments: Vane alive, begging her to remember something, and a word — 'Ledger.' Emotional beat: painful excavation; hope and violation in the same breath.

chapters.title: Containment
chapters.summary: Ilsa's POV. Lantern's cleaners hit the safehouse while the group is out. Petra is taken; the rest scatter. Elodie realizes the invitation list itself was leaked — someone inside their circle is reporting. Emotional beat: loss and suspicion fusing into resolve.

chapters.title: Every Exit Is an Entrance
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. On the run through Marseille, she uses her contractor tradecraft against her trainers, shaking surveillance and making contact with Vane's old courier. The courier delivers half of the Ledger: names of every edited operative and every buyer. Emotional beat: agency reclaimed; the hunted begins hunting.

chapters.title: Petra's Voice
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, captive. Interrogated gently, professionally, she realizes Lantern intends to re-edit her rather than kill her — erasure instead of execution. She feeds her captors true-but-useless information to buy time. Emotional beat: dignity under erasure; loyalty tested from the inside.

chapters.title: The Second Half
chapters.summary: Sefu's POV. The courier's second delivery includes Vane's final video: he faked his death to force Lantern to activate its own contingency, exposing the Ledger's location. His last words are addressed to Elodie by her pre-Lantern name. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into inheritance — Vane's truth becomes hers to carry.

chapters.title: Traitor's Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Cross-referencing leaks against the invitation timeline, she identifies the informant: the fourth alumnus, Tomas, still running on an active edit. Confronting him, she finds a man desperate to be loyal to something real. Emotional beat: compassion for the enemy; the cost of manufactured devotion made human.

chapters.title: The Summit
chapters.summary: Ilsa's POV. Lantern convenes its annual buyer summit in Geneva to auction new contracts — and to display a 'recovered asset': Petra, freshly wiped, presented as proof of product reliability. Emotional beat: horror at scale; the machinery confident and visible at last.

chapters.title: Doors and Ledgers
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Using Tomas's access codes and the summit's own security obsession against it, the team infiltrates the venue. Elodie reaches the server room holding the master Ledger while Sefu creates chaos above. Emotional beat: taut, procedural tension — everything staked on precision.

chapters.title: Ilsa's Offer
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV, face-to-face with Ilsa in the archive. Ilsa offers Elodie her original memories back — sealed in a vault — if she hands over the Ledger and rejoins. For one long minute, Elodie wants it more than freedom. Emotional beat: the climax of the internal war; loyalty to self vs. longing for wholeness.

chapters.title: Burn Notice
chapters.summary: Climax, multiple POVs converging. Elodie refuses, broadcasts the Ledger to every buyer's screen mid-auction, and triggers the vault's failsafe so no one — including her — can ever buy those memories back. Petra, half-wiped, chooses to testify. Ilsa is arrested by the buyers she thought she owned. Emotional beat: catharsis through irreversible choice.

chapters.title: Aftermath, Unedited
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Weeks later: hearings, leaks, alumni scattered into ordinary lives. Sefu asks what she'll do with a past she can't recover. Elodie says she'll build one worth remembering. Emotional beat: raw, unsentimental healing beginning.

chapters.title: The Real Name
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. A final envelope from Vane's estate contains her pre-Lantern birth certificate and a single line: 'You were always going to choose this.' She reads her real name aloud, alone, then packs the go-bag — lighter now. Emotional beat: bittersweet closure; identity as something chosen, not recovered.

chapters.title: Theo and the Deadline
chapters.summary: Epilogue, Elodie's POV. Months on, she takes one client: a whistleblower named Theo, hunted before he can testify. As the deadline hits, Elodie stands between him and the last of Lantern's freelancers — guarding someone everyone trusts, finally including herself. Emotional beat: full-circle resolution; the guard who learned the truth keeps watch with open eyes.
